name: Spanish
note: Grade of C (2.0) or higher required in all courses counted toward the minor. Four courses beyond Intermediate Spanish II (SPA-225); with consent of the department chair, one class in translation (SPA-148, SPA-457, ENG-357, or other) may count as one of the four. Elementary Spanish (SPA-115/125), Spanish Review and Preparation (SPA-135), and Intermediate Spanish (SPA-215/225) do not count toward the minor.

sections.label: Introduction to Hispanic Literature or Hispanic Life and Culture
sections.description: Either SPA-345 or SPA-336/SPA-338 must be taken as part of the four credits.

sections.label: Four Courses Beyond SPA-225
sections.description: Four courses in Spanish beyond Intermediate Spanish II (SPA-225).
